description: This Java source file defines the class VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter, which extends AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter to implement an MQTT protocol adapter using Vert.x for the Eclipse Hono project. It handles MQTT message processing, including mapping topics, validating address types, and handling QoS policies for telemetry, event, and command messages.

classes.name: VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter
classes.description: An MQTT protocol adapter implementation for Hono that uses Vert.x for asynchronous message processing and enforces QoS and endpoint rules.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the protocol adapter type name, which is 'mqtt'.

methods.name: onPublishedMessage
methods.description: Handles the event when a message is published via MQTT, mapping the topic, validating, and uploading the message.

methods.name: mapTopic
methods.description: Maps an MQTT topic to a ResourceIdentifier, applying rules based on endpoint type and QoS to validate message suitability.
